scopedCoverageNotes.note: One Oakland County packet: all 121 local office fields in the current 36-page official county list, with 117 complete active named fields, four held fields and separately retained nonprinted filings. Acquired municipal samples span 152 physical pages, 76 selected precinct styles in Farmington Hills, Southfield, Waterford and Bloomfield Township; 27 complete fields independently corroborated. This is partial county sample-style coverage. Cross-county school/college/library fields retain their complete district electorates, and shared Wayne identities are reused. No blanket Oakland County fallback for district offices. State/federal/legislative contests and previously prepared measures are preserved unchanged.
